subject: english
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence.

Reena got__ embarrassed and started crying.__
solution:
The correct answer is **Humiliated and started weeping.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence can be improved by replacing the **"Embarassed and started crying" **with** "**Humiliated and started weeping**."**
 
• **Embarrased: **Feeling ashamed or timid.
 
 
• **Example: ***She felt embarrassed when teacher scolded her. *
 
 
 
• **Humiliated: **Someone who is made to feel foolish or ashamed.
 
 
• **Example: ***She felt humiliated in front of the whole class.* 
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct option is Humiliated and started weeping.

The correct sentence is: **Reena got h**umiliated and started weeping.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Frightened refers to a person who is afraid or concerned.
 
• Frustrated refers to getting frustrated or feeling less confident as a result of not getting what you desire.
 
• **Conscious **refers to a person who is awake, reasoning, and aware of his surroundings.
